daily_summary: 当日变更以性能优化与后端适配为主：NVPTX 目标专属算术向量化（替换 SLP，Python/C++ 双向打通并新增 disable_lsr/sched4reg/maxnreg 编译控制）、NVFP4→MXFP8 行缩放吸收到量化阶段以保持数值等价、AMD CDNA5 符号重命名（gfx1250→CDNA5）与 MFMA/WMMA 指令选择重构、RDNA CU 模式下的 barrier lowering 放行、masked load 负零保持修复。同时包含若干构建/测试基础设施与文档级修复（LLVM SDK 关闭 LZMA、GSan TCPStore 端口竞态修复、MockTensor stride、 extern 参数计数报错修正）。整体方向是继续解耦平台特定优化、增强编译可调参数化，并以纯 NFC 重命名降低后续维护成本。
ascend_impact_summary: 当日对 triton-ascend 影响有限但有一处硬相关：commit 139ac39 修改 python/src/ir.cc 的 FuncOp 绑定接口（新增 get_arg_str_attr/get_arg_int_attr），命中 Ascend 的‘必然影响’路径（ir.cc 是 TritonOpBuilder 继承与绑定层），但仅新增方法不改签名，兼容性风险低；其余 NVPTX 向量化（新增 NVPTXVectorizerPass 与 llvm.cc 新增参数）、SLP 开关、AMD 全部 changes、kernels 数值改动、测试/CI/构建修复均不触及 Ascend 的编译链与运行时接口。triton-ascend 应关注 ir.cc 变更以避免后续 rebase 冲突，无需功能性适配，也无需新增测试。

commits.comment: 将 NVFP4 外层的行缩放（tensor_scale）提前吸收到 NVFP4→MXFP8 的 requantize 中，使 s*(Q(x)@W) 变为 Q(s*x)@W，避免 epilogue 中再做一次行缩放，从而消除相关 shared memory 临时空间。改动包括：nvfp4_to_mxfp8_tile 增加可选 tensor_scale 参数（把 scales *= tensor_scale[:,None]），_matmul/_p_matmul 引入 has_x_epilogue_scale 并在 REQUANTIZE_X 时加载 x_conversion_scale 传入，opt_flags 的 subtiles_to_check 过滤掉无法容纳完整量化组的 epilogue subtile，opt_flags_nvidia.compute_num_stages 改为只在非 requantize 情况下为 a_mx_tensor_scale 预留 epilogue smem，并新增测试 test_nvfp4_requantization_matches_mxfp8 及扩展 tile 测试。属于数值等价前提下的性能/显存优化，风险中等在于必须与显式转换路径 bitwise 一致（测试已给出 enforce_bitwise_invariance 校验）。

ascend_impact.functionality: 无影响。改动全部在 python/triton_kernels/ 的 matmul/numerics 实现与测试中，属于 Python 层的 kernel 逻辑与调优选项，与 triton-ascend 的后端编译链无耦合。

commits.message:
[KERNELS] Absorb NVFP4 row scales during MXFP8 conversion (#12285)

Apply NVFP4 row scales before MXFP8 quantization in both matmul kernels,
matching explicit conversion followed by MXFP8 × MXFP4 matmul. Update
shared-memory accounting to exclude the removed row-scale epilogue
scratch.

```text
s: outer row scale
x: NVFP4 activations decoded with block scales, before applying s
W: MXFP4 weight matrix
Q: MXFP8 quantization

Before: s * (Q(x) @ W)
After:  Q(s * x) @ W
```

Tested on GB300, including exact parity for fused outputs; reduce the
related matmul test matrix from 400 to 200 cases.

commits.comment: 变更意图：把已有的编译器控制开关暴露到 triton_kernels 的公共 API 上，让调用方在不改动 kernel 算术语义的前提下调优。具体为：(1) topk_forward/topk 新增可选参数 disable_lsr（默认 None），仅在非 None 时以 kwargs 方式传给 _topk_forward 启动，从而对 CUDA forward kernel 覆盖 loop strength reduction；同时 TopK.autograd.Function.forward/backward 的参数列表与返回的梯度个数同步增加一个 None（保持 autograd 参数计数一致）。(2) reduce.py 的 OptFlags 数据类新增 maxnreg/sched4reg 两个 Optional 字段，_select_reduce_forward_config 从 _opt_flags_constraints ContextVar 中读出这两个键组成 launch_options 并透传到所有 OptFlags 构造点，reduce_forward 启动时再次用 walrus 表达式过滤 None 后才作为启动 kwargs 传入——确保未设置时不产生任何额外启动选项，也就不会把 CUDA 专有选项泄漏到其它后端。实现方式整体是防御性的条件 kwargs 构造，默认行为与改动前完全一致。潜在风险：低。需要注意的点是 TopK.forward/backward 与 topk() 的位置依赖参数顺序——forward 新增的 disable_lsr 加在末尾并于 backward 返回同样数量的 None，若后续再追加参数需同步更新两处；另外 _topk_forward 必须实际接受 disable_lsr 这个关键字（launch option），若未支持会在此处报错，但这属于该 PR 显式声明的既有控制项。
commits.message:
[KERNELS] Expose top-k and reduction compilation controls (#12282)

Expose optional `disable_lsr` for top-k forward and
`maxnreg`/`sched4reg` through the reduction optimization flags. These
allow callers to tune the existing compiler controls without modifying
kernel arithmetic. Unset options are omitted from launches, preserving
the current defaults and avoiding CUDA-specific options on other
backends.

Based on current main, including #11478. Pre-commit checks and eight
manual CPU checks passed for default configuration, option forwarding,
scoped overrides, and autograd argument counts. Those CPU checks use
mocked GPU dispatch; GPU correctness and performance tests have not been
rerun for this PR.

commits.comment: 用 NVIDIA 目标感知的 ad hoc 向量化器替换 SLP 向量化器（大型 PR，+3287 行）。新增 lib/Target/LLVMIR/LLVMIRNVPTXVectorizer.cpp（约 1370 行）与 NVPTXVectorizerPass，实现按 compute capability 判断支持的 packed 运算（f16/bf16/f32、FMA、int16 umax、fabs sign mask 等）、基于 dominator/成本模型的打包规划、循环累加器合并、循环携带（loop carry）打包等技术；triton-llvm-opt 新增 -nvptx-vectorize/-nvptx-compute-capability；python/src/llvm.cc 将 NVPTXVectorizerPass 接入 optimize_module（新增 nvptx_compute_capability 参数）并为 translate_to_asm 新增 disable_lsr 参数与 ScopedLSRPassGate（基于 LLVMContext 的 OptPassGate，使并行编译可独立选择），同时新增 TRITON_USE_SLP_VECTORIZER knob；third_party/nvidia/backend/compiler.py 增加 disable_lsr 选项并将 SLP 关闭改为 opt-in、按 capability 传入 nvptx_compute_capability；GetEnv.h 加入 TRITON_USE_SLP_VECTORIZER 缓存失效变量。改动大且涉及 LLVM IR 层代码生成，性能影响明显（可能改变寄存器压力，故同时提供 sched4reg/maxnreg 调节）；风险中高，主要在序列语义与正确性方面，已有详尽 lit 覆盖（test/LLVMIR/nvptx-vectorizer.ll，1776 行）与 python/test/unit/test_knobs.py 的 LSR/并发用例保护。

ascend_impact.functionality: 无影响。向量化器为 NVPTX 专用（third_party/nvidia/backend/compiler.py、lib/Target/LLVMIR、bin/triton-llvm-opt、python/src/llvm.cc 的 NVPTX 相关分支），Ascend 后端不经过 NVPTX 代码生成、不使用 CUDAOptions 的 disable_lsr/sched4reg、也不走 llvm.optimize_module 的 NVPTX 路径；python/src/llvm.cc 中新增的 disable_lsr 参数位于 llvm.translate_to_asm 绑定上，但属于带默认值的新增参数，Ascend 若未调用该方法则无影响。

commits.message:
[BACKEND] Replace NVIDIA SLP with target-aware arithmetic vectorization (#11478)

Replace SLP vectorizer for Nvidia backend by an ad hoc vectorizer
specialized to Nvidia target.

This may cause some important performance changes because SLP vectorizer
reorders aggressively. Using `sched4reg` or `maxnreg` option can help
solve problems for kernel that now have high pressure due to less
reordering.
There is an option to turn SLP back on however we will later update the
LLVM target causing SLP vectorizer to stop reordering as aggressively.

commits.comment: 在 LLVM SDK 构建中关闭 LLVM_ENABLE_LZMA（两个平台的 cmake 调用均加 -DLLVM_ENABLE_LZMA=OFF），并把 cmake/llvm-build-info.json 的 build_number 从 1 升到 2 以发布新的不可变 archive。原因是该 LLVM revision 自动探测 liblzma 并把它加入 LLVMSupport 的导出链接接口，在没有 liblzma 开发库的 CI runner 上配置失败，阻塞后续 PR。Triton 不需要 LLVM 可选 xz 支持。纯构建基础设施改动，不影响编译逻辑。

ascend_impact.functionality: 无影响。仅 LLVM SDK 的构建配置与 build number，不改变 Triton 的编译器行为。

commits.message:
[BUILD] Disable LZMA in LLVM SDKs (#12262)

Disable `LLVM_ENABLE_LZMA` in the LLVM SDK build on every platform and
publish build 2 of `18f9e623e4c891ba31ff817c07197707ac9bc593`.

This LLVM revision auto-detects liblzma and adds `LibLZMA::LibLZMA` to
the exported `LLVMSupport` link interface. The build-1 Ubuntu SDKs
therefore fail to configure on CI runners without liblzma development
files, blocking #12236 and its child #12237. Triton's SDKs do not need
LLVM's optional xz decompression support.

The build-number bump requests fresh, immutable archives. After this PR
merges and publication finishes, #12236 can consume build 2 with the new
archive checksums. LLVM builds remain restricted to main pushes and
manual dispatch.

Validation on Brix GB300 with the exact LLVM source tree for `18f9e623`:
- Reproduced the exported-target failure with the published build-1 SDK
and `CMAKE_DISABLE_FIND_PACKAGE_LibLZMA=TRUE`.
- Rebuilt `LLVMSupport` with `LLVM_ENABLE_LZMA=OFF`; its exported link
interface no longer contains LibLZMA.
- A separate SDK consumer configured, linked, and ran successfully with
LibLZMA discovery disabled, verifying xz support is disabled.
- Pre-commit checks passed. The full SDK matrix will run after merge.

commits.comment: 修复 GSan 分布式测试的 rendezvous 端口竞态：原实现先用 _get_free_tcp_port() 探测空闲端口后关闭 socket，再由 rank 0 启动服务，中间窗口可能被其他进程抢占导致 EADDRINUSE。改为在父进程中以端口 0 创建真正的 dist.TCPStore 并保持存活直到所有 worker 退出，worker 一律以 is_master=False 通过 _connect_to_store 连接并把 store 显式传给 init_process_group，同时移除 MASTER_ADDR/MASTER_PORT 环境变量设置。所有 25 个对称内存用例在此实现下通过。属测试基础设施修复，风险低。

ascend_impact.functionality: 无影响。仅 python/test/gsan/test_symmetric_memory.py 的测试进程编排，与 Ascend 的编译链和运行时无关。

commits.message:
[GSan] Fix distributed test rendezvous port race (#12266)

The distributed symmetric-memory tests can fail with `EADDRINUSE`
because `_get_free_tcp_port()` releases its socket before rank 0 starts
the rendezvous server. Another process can claim the port during that
gap, as in [this CI
failure](https://github.com/triton-lang/triton/actions/runs/38344466586/job/115122601268?pr=11478).

Start the actual `TCPStore` in the parent on an OS-assigned port and
keep it alive until all workers exit. Every worker, including rank 0,
connects as a client and passes the store explicitly to
`init_process_group`.

Validation:
- All 25 existing symmetric-memory test cases passed on GB300 using a
prebuilt Triton runtime, including the reported failing case.
- All pre-commit checks passed, including Ruff, YAPF, and mypy.

commits.comment: 修复 MockTensor.stride()（python/triton/runtime/jit.py）对 rank>=3 的张量返回错误步长的问题：原实现用 shape[1:] 前向累乘再反转，导致 [2,3,4] 返回 (12,3,1) 而非 (12,4,1)。改为从最后一维向后累乘再反转，得到标准行主序步长。此错误会影响以多维 MockTensor 预热时的 specialization/alignment 决策。改动小、语义明确，风险低。

ascend_impact.functionality: 无影响。JITFunction/JITCallable 被 Ascend 直接复用，但本变更仅修正 MockTensor.stride() 的计算，不改变特化键格式、缓存键计算或参数绑定输出形态，Ascend kernel 的编译缓存与启动器生成行为不受影响。

commits.message:
Update jit.py (#12272)

Fix MockTensor.stride() returning incorrect strides for rank ≥ 3 shapes

MockTensor.stride() computed the cumulative stride product using
shape[1:] in forward order instead of walking dimensions from the last
one backward. This gave correct results for rank ≤ 2 shapes but wrong
strides for any mocked tensor with 3+ dimensions (e.g. shape=[2,3,4]
returned (12, 3, 1) instead of the correct (12, 4, 1)), which can affect
specialization/alignment decisions when warming up a kernel with a
multi-dimensional MockTensor.

Fix: accumulate the stride starting from the last dimension and reverse
at the end, matching standard row-major stride computation.

commits.message:
Update core.py (#12274)

Fix swapped “expect/got” values in dispatch()’s argument-count error
message

When the number of arguments passed to an extern function doesn’t match
the expected count, dispatch() raises a ValueError with the expected and
actual counts reversed: it reports Expect {len(args)}, got {num_args}
instead of Expect {num_args}, got {len(args)}. This makes the error
message say the opposite of what actually happened, which is confusing
when debugging a mismatched extern-function call.

commits.comment: 允许 RDNA 在 CU 模式（wgp_cu_mode="cu"）下走 tagged barrier lowering：只有当所有 wave 共享同一 L0 时，local-only fence（省略 vector cache invalidate）才安全，因此 BarrierOp 的 lowering 改为对 CDNA 或（RDNA 且 cuMode）走 tagged 路径。为此 TargetInfo 增加 cuMode 字段与 isCuMode()，createConvertTritonAMDGPUToLLVMPass/add_to_llvmir 增加 cuMode 参数，Passes.td 增加 cu-mode option，HIPBackend 在调用时传入 options.wgp_cu_mode == "cu"。新增 lit RUN lines（gfx1100/gfx1200 cu-mode）与 GPU 端 test_reduce_cu_mode 验证跨 wave 归约在两种模式下的正确性。属后端功能扩展，风险集中在对 CU/WGP 语义边界的正确判断上。

ascend_impact.functionality: 无影响。变更全部位于 third_party/amd（HIPBackend、TritonAMDGPUToLLVM 的 Passes/TargetInfo/MemoryOpToLLVM、triton_amd.cc 绑定）与 AMD lit/GPU 测试，属于 ROCm 专属的 barrier lowering 与 target feature，Ascend 不走该路径。

commits.message:
[AMD] Allow the tagged barrier lowering on RDNA in CU mode (#11911)

Enable address-space-tagged barriers on RDNA when `wgp_cu_mode="cu"`. A
local-only fence omits the vector cache invalidate, so an acquire in one
wave can cover the work-group only when all waves share one L0. CU mode
provides that sharing; WGP mode spans two CUs and retains the generic
lowering that fixed the split-cumsum regression.

The option controls both barrier lowering and the LLVM target feature.
Existing default-mode lit checks remain, with CU-mode checks for gfx1100
and gfx1200. A cross-wave reduction test checks the selected lowering
and execution in both modes.

Validation: rebuilt with `make`; all pre-commit checks passed. All 124
AMD lit tests and three focused GPU cases passed. Split-cumsum matched
the eager reference over 20 iterations per case for float32, float64,
int32, and int64 in flat and row layouts, in both WGP and CU modes. The
float64/int64 kernels retain eight barriers while `buffer_gl0_inv` drops
from nine in WGP mode to one in CU mode.
